$comment: Verdicts for programs that start at sign-in, matched case-insensitively on the entry's name. '*' at the end of a pattern matches any ending. 'keep' wins over 'optional'. Everything else is 'unknown'.

keep.SecurityHealth: Windows Security's tray icon and alerts
keep.1Password*: Password manager: keeps your vault ready
keep.Bitwarden*: Password manager: keeps your vault ready
keep.Tailscale*: VPN: keeps you on your tailnet

optional.Spotify: Opens Spotify at sign-in; start it when you want music
optional.Discord: Chat app; open it when you need it
optional.Steam: Game launcher; also updates games in the background
optional.Teams*: Microsoft Teams; open it before meetings
optional.Zoom*: Zoom; meeting links still open it
optional.Slack: Slack; open it when you start work
optional.OneDrive: Files stop syncing until you open OneDrive
optional.Dropbox: Files stop syncing until you open Dropbox
optional.GoogleDriveFS: Files stop syncing until you open Google Drive
optional.Docker Desktop: Starts Docker and its VM at sign-in; start it when you need containers
optional.Ollama*: Starts the Ollama server at sign-in
optional.Logi*: Logitech software; extra buttons may need it
optional.Razer*: Razer software; lighting and buttons may need it
optional.AnyDesk: Remote access: also accepts incoming connections
optional.TeamViewer*: Remote access: also accepts incoming connections
optional.LGHUB: Logitech G HUB; mouse and keyboard profiles may need it
optional.Logitech G HUB*: Logitech G HUB; mouse and keyboard profiles may need it
optional.Plex Media Server: Media server; starts streaming at sign-in
optional.IDMan: Internet Download Manager; open it when you download
optional.WingetUI: UniGetUI package updates in the background
optional.UniGetUI*: UniGetUI package updates in the background
optional.Warp: Warp terminal; open it when you need it
optional.Everything: File search index; search is slower to start without it
optional.Flameshot: Screenshot tool; Print Screen may rely on it
optional.Docker Desktop*: Starts Docker and its VM at sign-in; start it when you need containers
